mathematics.assertion_tested: Independent complete point counts reproduce all smooth Beal-model Frobenius polynomials at q=11 and19 and their precise full-polynomial trace-zero loci modulo7.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact finite-field arithmetic over F_q and F_q[z]/(z^2-d), d a nonsquare; quadratic character in F_q^2 computed through norm to F_q.
mathematics.conventions: Frobenius coefficients ordered constant through leading coefficient. Two infinity points because sextic is monic. Smooth pairs satisfy A^3+B^5 nonzero modulo q.

bounds.A_B: Every pair in F_q^2 satisfying A^3+B^5 nonzero:110 at11 and342 at19
bounds.point_counts: Every point coordinate in F_q andF_q^2

non_claims: Does not independently establish modular attachment or level lowering.
Does not independently prove the multiplicative-prime comparison.
Does not eliminate any Hilbert form.
